mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% for two consecutive months signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, which raises discount rates and reduces present value of future corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the median return is not statistically different from zero at 95% confidence.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (proxied by GDPC1) exceeding 2% coincident with a housing starts contraction (HOUST) below 1,000K units for three consecutive months signals weakening aggregate demand, which depresses corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 YoY < -2% AND HOUST < 1000 for 3 months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered episodes, or the average return is not significantly below zero at 90% confidence.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 6% for two consecutive months, accompanied by a decline in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) for the same period, signals deteriorating labor market conditions that erode consumer spending and corporate margins, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 6% for 2 consecutive months AND PAYEMS < previous month for 2 months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 35% of triggered episodes, or the median return is not statistically different from zero at 95% confidence.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) below 98 for three consecutive months signals a broad-based slowdown in manufacturing output, which reduces corporate revenue and profit growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during INDPRO < 98 episodes, or the average return is positive at 90% confidence.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in the federal funds rate below 1% for two consecutive months signals an emergency easing cycle, which boosts risk appetite and equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during triggered episodes, or the median return is not above zero at 95% confidence.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in real personal savings (RSAFS) and a decline in personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a shift from spending to saving, which typically precedes a consumer-driven recession and results in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS > previous quarter AND GDPC1 < previous quarter for 2 consecutive quarters
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 30% of triggered episodes, or the average return is not significantly below zero at 90% confidence.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5 percentage points in a single month, with concurrent declines in both nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) and industrial production (INDPRO), signals a synchronized labor and supply shock that depresses earnings and triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp AND PAYEMS < previous month AND INDPRO < previous month in the same month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during triggered episodes, or the median return is not below zero at 95% confidence.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 1,500K units for four consecutive months signals a robust residential investment cycle, which boosts construction-related equities and supports broader economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during triggered episodes, or the median return is not above zero at 90% confidence.
